```plato

    // The point set after one repulsion pass. Every point moves from the same
    // starting configuration — the pass is a simultaneous step, not a sweep — so
    // the result does not depend on the order the points are stored in.
    RepelledPoints2D(region: Bounds2D, points: Array<Point2D>, radius: Number,
        strength: Number): Array<Point2D>
    {
        var moved = Point2D.NoPoints;
        var i = 0;
        while (i < points.Count)
        {
            moved = moved.Append(RepelledPoint2D(region, points, radius, strength, i));
            i = i + 1;
        }
        return moved;
    }
```
